extracted.intended_audience: general Japanese news readers / visitors of the Asahi Shimbun website
extracted.subtask_description: Online front page of a major Japanese newspaper (Asahi Shimbun) that aggregates headlines, section links, and site navigation for readers. The page organizes news by topic (society, politics, international, sports, culture, etc.) and includes notices about services and copyright.
